verdict.rationale: Column is a developer-facing banking API platform with a dashboard, so whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Roles, API key modes and sandbox isolation are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
